slides.say: React Compiler is a build time tool that memoizes your components and values automatically.
You write plain code. The compiler skips cascading re-renders and caches expensive calculations, even with that inline arrow.

slides.text: It understands the Rules of React. Works with Babel, Vite, Metro, Rsbuild.
slides.say: It works with plain JavaScript and understands the Rules of React, so you do not rewrite code. It plugs into Babel, Vite, Metro and Rsbuild.

slides.text: New code: rely on it. useMemo/useCallback remain escape hatches.
slides.say: For new code, rely on the compiler, and use use memo or use callback only when you need precise control, like a stable Effect dependency.
